zh: 别担心，我明天把文件发给你。
en: Don't worry, I {will send|am going to send|will email} you the file tomorrow.

zh: 看那些乌云，马上要下雨了。
en: Look at those dark clouds. It {is going to rain|is about to rain|will rain} soon.

zh: 我们明天上午十点和客户开会，已经约好了。
en: We {are meeting|are going to meet|will be meeting|will meet} the client at ten tomorrow morning — it's all arranged.

zh: 火车明天早上六点半出发。
en: The train {leaves|departs|is leaving|will leave|will depart} at half past six tomorrow morning.

zh: 快点，电影马上就要开始了。
en: Hurry up, the film {is about to start|is going to start|is starting|is about to begin|is going to begin|is beginning}.

zh: “电话响了。”“我来接。”
en: "The phone's ringing." "I {will get|will answer|will grab} it."

zh: 我觉得明年房价会上涨。
en: I think house prices {will go|are going to go} up next year.

zh: 她下个月开始一份新工作。
en: She {is starting|is going to start|starts|will start|will be starting} a new job next month.

zh: 我打算今年夏天学游泳。
en: I {am going to learn|will learn} to swim this summer — that's my plan.

zh: 我的航班周五晚上八点到达奥克兰。
en: My flight {arrives|is arriving|will arrive|lands|is landing|will land} in Auckland at eight on Friday evening.

zh: 我今晚和朋友一起吃晚饭，我们已经订好位了。
en: I {am having|am going to have} dinner with friends tonight — we've already booked a table.

zh: 我保证不会把惊喜派对的事告诉任何人。
en: I promise I {won't tell|will not tell} anyone about the surprise party.

zh: 小心！你要把咖啡洒到键盘上了。
en: Careful! You {are going to spill|are about to spill|will spill} coffee on the keyboard.

zh: 大会下周一上午九点开始。
en: The conference {begins|will begin|starts|will start|is starting|is beginning} at nine next Monday morning.

zh: 飞机马上就要起飞了，请关掉手机。
en: The plane {is about to take|is going to take} off, so please switch off your phone.

zh: 你这个周六打算做什么？
en: What are you {doing|going to do} this Saturday?

zh: 别担心，我肯定他明天不会迟到。
en: Don't worry, I'm sure he {won't be|will not be|isn't going to be|is not going to be} late tomorrow.

zh: 那个箱子看起来很重，我来帮你搬。
en: That box looks heavy. I {will help} you carry it.

zh: 我们下个月搬到惠灵顿，租约已经签了。
en: We {are moving|are going to move|will be moving|will move} to Wellington next month — we've already signed the lease.

zh: 超市今晚九点关门。
en: The supermarket {closes|is closing|will close} at nine tonight.

zh: 电量只剩百分之一，我的手机马上要关机了。
en: The battery is at one percent. My phone {is about to die|is going to die|will die|is about to shut down|is going to shut down|will shut down|is about to switch off|is going to switch off|will switch off}.

zh: 我明天下午三点去看医生，已经预约了。
en: I {am seeing|am going to see|will see|will be seeing} the doctor at three tomorrow afternoon — I've got an appointment.

zh: 明年我就四十岁了。
en: I {will be|am going to be|will turn|am going to turn|turn} forty next year.

zh: 他明年不打算续签合同。
en: He {isn't going to renew|is not going to renew|won't renew|will not renew|isn't renewing|is not renewing} his contract next year.

zh: 你明天来参加聚会吗？
en: Are you {coming|going to come} to the party tomorrow?

zh: 我们打算下周末粉刷厨房，昨天已经把油漆买好了。
en: We {are going to paint|are painting|will paint} the kitchen next weekend — we bought the paint yesterday.

zh: 今晚下一班去机场的巴士几点发车？
en: What time {does|will} the next bus {leave|depart|go} for the airport tonight?

zh: 我马上要去开会了，晚点给你回电话好吗？
en: I {am about to go|am going|am going to go} into a meeting — can I call you back later?

zh: “我饿了。”“我给你做个三明治。”
en: "I'm hungry." "I {will make} you a sandwich."

zh: 天气预报说明天会下雪。
en: The forecast says it {will snow|is going to snow} tomorrow.

zh: 她怀孕了，六月份要生孩子。
en: She's pregnant. She {is going to have|is having|will have} a baby in June.

zh: 我们团队下周二发布新版本，日期已经定了。
en: Our team {is releasing|is going to release|will release|will be releasing|releases|is launching|is going to launch|will launch|launches} the new version next Tuesday — the date is fixed.

zh: 我的签证下个月到期。
en: My visa {expires|will expire|is going to expire|is expiring|runs out|will run out|is going to run out} next month.

zh: 我今晚不做饭了，我们点外卖吧。
en: I {am not going to cook|am not cooking|won't cook|will not cook} tonight — let's get takeaways.

zh: 你打算什么时候把新工作的事告诉老板？
en: When are you {going to tell|telling} your boss about the new job?

zh: IT团队今晚十一点重启服务器，这是计划好的维护。
en: The IT team {is restarting|is going to restart|will restart|will be restarting} the server at eleven tonight — it's planned maintenance.

zh: 我想我今晚就点鱼吧。
en: I think I {will order|am going to order|will have|am going to have|will get} the fish tonight.

zh: 比赛马上就要结束了，只剩一分钟。
en: The game {is about to finish|is going to finish|is about to end|is going to end} — there's only a minute left.

zh: 明天是公共假日，银行不开门。
en: The bank {won't open|will not open|doesn't open|does not open|isn't opening|is not opening|isn't going to open|is not going to open} tomorrow because it's a public holiday.

zh: 你觉得周六的比赛谁会赢？
en: Who do you think {will win|is going to win} the game on Saturday?
